components.description: Objects to create. Each: unique ref + one of type|param|panel|slider|valueList|toggle.

ref.description: Local name for later entries and batches; letters, digits, _ -; lowercase by convention.

type.description: Exact name, 'Category/Name', 'Category/Subcategory/Name' or GUID. Never loose.

panel.description: Panel text. A list is one value per line (no Text Split).

multiline.description: Panel: false (default) one item per line; true whole text one item.

nickname.description: Only when wanted; unique. Capitals on key inputs/outputs.

y.description: Omit x and y for auto-layout.

set.description: Change new or existing objects. target: object, or 'obj.port' for an input value.

value.description: number|bool|string|{point:[x,y,z]}|{vector:[x,y,z]}|{domain:[a,b]}, a list, or null to clear. Slider/toggle/value list/panel: value, state, item, text.

inputModifiers.description: Listed ports get exactly these settings; [] clears.

insert.description: {ref, on:[output,input], in, out}: put a new component into an existing wire. in/out default 0.

wires.description: [output, input] pairs. End = 'obj.port' (last dot splits; port = index, name or nickname), 'obj' for single-port objects, or {obj, port}. obj = ref, unique nickname, GUID or 8+ char GUID prefix.

disconnect.description: [output, input] pairs to remove; "*" on one side = all wires into that input / out of that output.

groups.description: {name, color, members} creates; {extend: name|GUID, members, color} adds. color #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

options.description: atomic (true), dryRun (false), solve (true), returnRuntimeMessages (true), maxOperations (1000), timeoutSeconds (60), watch ([]: up to 10 outputs, "obj" or "obj.port", refs from this batch included, read back after the solve as count (and how many are empty), branches and a short preview).
